objectives.goal: Remove every hardcoded decision from the Decision Engine.
Generate execution plans from mission objectives instead of fixed logic.
done_when: Execution plan changes according to the mission.

objectives.goal: Continue executing objectives until mission completion.
done_when: Runtime automatically continues after each completed objective.
Runtime stops only on completion or blocking error.
Automatic validation runs after every change.
Mission progress is updated after every objective.

objectives.goal: After mission completion, identify improvements for the Runtime.
done_when: Runtime generates at least one improvement mission.

completion: Mission executed without unnecessary human intervention.
